title: Libra Symbol: Copy & Paste ♎ — The Only Zodiac Sign That's Not a Person or Animal
meta_description: Copy and paste the Libra zodiac symbol (♎) — a literal balance scale, and the only symbol in the entire zodiac that represents an object instead of an animal or person. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: Libra's glyph (♎) is a literal balance scale — the only symbol among all 12 zodiac signs that depicts an object rather than an animal, person, or hybrid creature. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The Libra symbol (♎, U+264E) is drawn as a balance scale, and it's genuinely unique among the zodiac: every other sign symbolizes an animal, a person, or a mythological hybrid — Libra is the only one that represents an inanimate object. The scales trace back to Themis, the Greek goddess of divine law and order (or, in some tellings, her daughter Astraea) — the same set of scales behind the modern ‘Scales of Justice’ imagery used in courtrooms and legal branding today. Libra runs September 23–October 22, is ruled by Venus, and is an Air sign with Cardinal modality.
